title: Switch On, Switch Off
summary: Learn how to safely turn a computer on and off.
objectives: Understand that computers need to be turned on/off properly

steps.boltSpeech: Before we can play, we have to wake the computer up!

content.text: Computers need electricity to work. We use the Power Button to turn them on.
content.svgContent: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="150px" height="150px"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="8"/><line x1="50" y1="10" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

steps.boltSpeech: What needs electricity to turn on?
steps.instructions: Sort the pictures into 'Needs Electricity' or 'No Electricity'.

steps.boltSpeech: When we are done, we must ask a grown-up to turn it off properly.

points.text: Ask a grown-up for help to turn it off.
